subject: Debrief: Oliver Grant (SRE candidate) — tiebreak discussion & next steps
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12 09:03 AM -0700
Subject: Debrief: Oliver Grant (SRE candidate) — request for scorecards

Team —

Thanks again for taking time to interview Oliver yesterday. He's a potential hire for the SRE role on infra. I've uploaded his resume and the interview rubric to the shared hiring drive. Can everyone post their scorecard and a 2–3 bullet justification by EOD? We're showing a slight split in raw scores and I want to capture the reasoning before we lock on next steps.

Quick context: Oliver has strong distributed systems fundamentals, decent on-call experience at a startup (scale ~100 services), but had a few gaps on deployment automation (Terraform patterns) and incident postmortem depth.

Links/attachments: drive: https://drive.google.com/teams/redwood/hiring/OLIVER-GRANT (internal), resume attached (resume-oliver-grant.pdf).

If you think we need an additional focused technical homework (30–45 mins) before moving forward, flag it here. Otherwise we'll aim to converge on a recommendation asap.

— Alex
Alex Martinez
Hiring lead, Platform SRE

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12 10:45 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Debrief: Oliver Grant (SRE candidate) — request for scorecards

Attaching my scorecard: scorecard-oliver-tessa.pdf (summary below).

Score (out of 5): System design 4, Debugging 5, Incident response 3, Automation 3, Communication 4 — overall 3.8

Notes:
- Strengths: strong debugging instincts, clear signal on triage and prioritization under time pressure.
- Concerns: limited hands-on Terraform work; when pushed on automation trade-offs he described more ad-hoc scripts vs infra-as-code patterns.
- Risk: borderline on our long-term automation charter; would need ramp support for IaC standards.

Recommendation: lean hire with pairing on automation and a 30-day onboarding plan focused on Terraform/CI.

— Tessa

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-07-12 13:10 PM -0700
Subject: Re: Debrief: Oliver Grant (SRE candidate) — preference and calibration

Thanks for collecting these. My assessment attached (scorecard-oliver-lauren.pdf). Short version: overall 3.5.

Reasoning:
- Interview 1 (system design): showed good choices for reliability and partition tolerance, but lacked concrete rollout/rollback steps for infra changes. That's a practical concern given the services he'll own.
- Interview 2 (on-call/incident): calm and methodical; good prioritization.
- Automation: limited examples of repo-level IaC ownership; sounded more like contributing than leading.

Hiring director note: I'm leaning toward hiring if we can mitigate automation risk with a 60-day onboarding deliverable + mentorship. If the panel is split, prefer scheduling a short (30-min) final sync with the hiring director to resolve operational fit.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Platform Engineering

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12 14:05 PM -0700
Subject: Re: Debrief: Oliver Grant (SRE candidate) — compensation and next steps

Putting candidate band info here so hiring/comp can move quickly if we decide to extend. Oliver's target is $150–170k base with equity expectations aligned to IC-3 band.

Attachments: resume-oliver-grant.pdf (clean copy).

My read: panel leans hire with the automation caveat; recommendation is to run 2 quick reference checks (one manager at previous company focusing on terraform/project ownership; one peer focusing on incident ownership) and then loop in hiring director for a 30-min calibration if refs are clean. If refs are solid, OK to move to verbal offer while comp is finalized.

— Marissa

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-07-12 15:42 PM -0700
Subject: Re: Debrief: Oliver Grant (SRE candidate) — consensus and owner assignment

Thanks everyone — good alignment here. Summary and action items: 

1) Consensus: move forward to reference checks and a short (30-min) director calibration if refs surface any questions. Panel leans hire contingent on references.
2) Owner: Marissa to run 2 reference checks (target complete by 2026-07-14).
3) Compensation: Marissa to confirm band and propose verbal offer range; we aim to stay within $150–170k base + IC-3 equity guidelines.
4) Onboarding mitigation: if hired, Alex/Tessa will own a 60-day automation ramp plan with clear deliverables.
5) Backstop: if refs are mixed, schedule a 30-min with Lauren to finalize operational fit.

Attachments: consensus-scorecard-oliver.pdf (combines submitted rubrics).

I'll draft the verbal offer language once Marissa confirms comp. Thanks for quick turn here — appreciate the fast responses.

— Alex
